_about: BF5 (2026-10-21): the raid re-measured on the halved cards and brambles (tools/raid_completion_model.js measure --n 20, docs/balance/raid-balance-bf5-fights.json; cycle 200 weeks a row). Read by tools/halve_2026_10_19.js doc.
lines: The fights were re-measured after the main merges (SK2b, MX; then TT, BX and the 10-21 re-derive): 20 fights a cell, the rebuilt reference decks at their maps' levels, every part at its five (Core: three) points of the raid. **Nothing in `raids.json` changed.** The fight builder halves it (`raidDefScaled`): the arms' and tail's bramble 350 → **175**, the Core 200 → **100**, the elders' floor 55 → **28**, and MX's raid Shield 50 → **25** a fresh raid (falling with the raid, as MX built it).
| Deck (reference) | Arms and tail: damage a fight, avg (fresh) | Bramble broken | Core: damage a fight | Core broken |
| Map 13 (normal, the Raid Banner) | **147 of 175** (131); before 168 of 350 (146) | **53%**; before 4% | 90 of 100; before 110 of 200 | 60%; before 23% |

**Completion is where RB2 / MX left it** (200 weeks a row, 60% of tickets, stand-ins 12% a day): **100% for 30 to 250 participants**, the raid falling on **day 6.53** with 30 (MX: 6.57) and **day 2.86** with 250. Raid damage a fight across the mix is **751** (MX: 736). Tiers (any participant-life): Participant **81%** (MX 76.5%), Competent **61%** (37.9%), Leading **0.2%** (0.1%).

**What changed is the feel, not the outcome.** Against the halved bramble every deck breaks it about half the time (it was 4% for a normal deck), and the four decks deal nearly the same (147–152 of 175): the fight saturates at the bramble, so the strong decks lose their edge and the weak ones gain. The skills' fixed numbers (Pounce, Thorns, Meteor, Armor; flagged above) didn't halve, so against halved brambles and halved units they weigh twice as much.

**No lever pulled** (completion holds, and the owner's raid levers are the brambles, the elders and the stages, each an owner call). One probe for the owner (measured before the second merge): the arms' and tail's stored bramble at **410** (205 in the fight; RB2's "less than 420") cuts the breaks to **30–39%** and the raid damage a fight to 603, and completion stays **100%** for 30+ (day 6.66 with 30), Competent 56.9%, Leading 0%. `node tools/raid_completion_model.js measure --n 20 --castle 410 --out FILE` re-runs it.
